query_text: site:rma.usda.gov OR site:usda.gov Federal Crop Insurance improper payments recoveries collections receivables debt CARS
query_scope: Search RMA and USDA materials for FCIC recovery, collection, receivable, debt, or CARS treatment connected to improper-payment dollars.
insufficient_result_rule: If results only restate improper-payment estimates or recovery-plan process language without collectible-dollar treatment, keep field closure and scoring blocked.
public_use_rule: Use as a methodology component gate source-query row only; not a savings estimate and not a finding of waste.

query_text: site:rma.usda.gov OR site:usda.gov Federal Crop Insurance compliance review data mining corrective action prevent improper payments dollars
query_scope: Search RMA and USDA compliance-review, data-mining, and corrective-action materials for preventable-dollar treatment tied to FCIC improper payments.
insufficient_result_rule: If results describe controls without tying them to preventable or recoverable dollars, keep scoring blocked.
public_use_rule: Use as a methodology component gate source-query row only; not a savings estimate and not a finding of waste.

program_or_activity: Purchased Long Term Services and Supports (PLTSS)
query_text: site:department.va.gov OR site:va.gov PLTSS incorrect amount overpayment bills of collection recoverable improper payments
query_scope: Search VA and VHA materials for PLTSS incorrect-amount findings converted to bills of collection, recoveries, debts, or collectible overpayments.
insufficient_result_rule: If results only report aggregate overpayments, improper payments, or unknown payments without recoverable incorrect-amount subset treatment, keep field closure and scoring blocked.
public_use_rule: Use as a methodology component gate source-query row only; not a savings estimate and not a finding of waste.

program_or_activity: Purchased Long Term Services and Supports (PLTSS)
query_text: site:department.va.gov OR site:va.gov PLTSS medical review documentation technical unknown incorrect amount recoverable overpayment
query_scope: Search VA and VHA PLTSS medical-review materials for error-category splits separating incorrect-amount recoverability from documentation, technical, and unknown-payment categories.
insufficient_result_rule: If results mix documentation defects or unknown payments with recoverable overpayments, keep scoring blocked.
public_use_rule: Use as a methodology component gate source-query row only; not a savings estimate and not a finding of waste.
